title: OPTDRV-006: `mmap()` results are stored without checking for `MAP_FAILED`
description:
OPTDRV-006: `mmap()` results are stored without checking for `MAP_FAILED`. A failed mapping is later read as image memory in `ReadFrame()` and later passed to `munmap()`, which can crash or corrupt exposure output under memory pressure or invalid buffer FDs. Check each mapping, unwind any mappings made for the request, and fail `StartCapture()` cleanly. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000024.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
